svg.desc: Condensed from 231 registered experiments (results.csv). Only turning points are drawn; every ID links to experiments/<ID>_*/. Numbers are ms/frame; the evidence level is stated on each node.. Generated by evolution_graph.cjs from graph.json; do not edit by hand.
svg.text: SRCNN on KV260: experiment evolution：Phase 4: ROM, clock and T4 workstream
Condensed from 231 registered experiments (results.csv). Only turning points are drawn; every ID links to experiments/<ID>_*/. Numbers
are ms/frame; the evidence level is stated on each node.
Metric: ms/frame = cycles x clock period. HLS = HLS estimated cycles x target clock; RTL x routed = C/RTL co-simulation cycles x an independently
closed post-route clock. No value is a board measurement.
Solid: baseline or parameter evolution, retry after fix, integration of an existing module; dashed: numerical evidence or inspiration, control,
verification of the same design, replay. Edges are design lineage, not Git history.

C17 C13 + 32-entry window FIFO Only the FIFO depth, reusing F47's evidence at T4 HLS 1.05 ms HLS estimate; RTL and routing needed passed with warning Sources: C13 (baseline or parameter evolution), F47 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

g.title: C22 Implement C17 at 5 ns RTL 273,023 cycles (C20); routed at 5.0 ns, WNS +0.013 RTL x routed 1.365 ms passed, comparable metric Sources: C17 (verification of the same design), C18 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

W36 Implement C17 at 4.5 ns Same RTL, tighter clock Setup fails: WNS -0.216 ns, worst paths are Winograd arithmetic with 8 to 11 logic levels failed or below gate Sources: C17 (verification of the same design), C22 (numerical evidence or inspiration)

C23 Gated parameter reload Load parameters once, reuse across frames HLS 1.05 ms RTL (C27) showed a 4-byte parameter read on a call that should skip loading passed with warning Sources: C13 (baseline or parameter evolution)

g.title: C28 Reload guard fix Stop HLS from hoisting a scalarized bias read RTL (C31): four calls exact, zero skipped-call AXI passed, comparable metric Sources: C23 (retry after fix)

C32 C17 + guarded reload Transplant only the reload interface into C17 RTL 273,025 cycles (C35) Implementation C36 fails 5 ns setup: WNS -0.102 failed or below gate Sources: C17 (baseline or parameter evolution), C28 (integration of an existing module)

C37 Registered parameter packet Add one 224-bit register stage between parameter FIFO and banks RTL 273,025 cycles (C39) Implementation C40 at 4.5 ns fails: WNS -0.278 failed or below gate Sources: C32 (baseline or parameter evolution)

C38 Balanced registered adder tree Four registered fabric-add levels in the Winograd fold HLS FF 248,672 exceeds the 230 k screen; stopped before RTL failed or below gate Sources: C32 (baseline or parameter evolution)
WSI System integration and board test Wrap the verified C22 IP with DDR and driver; measure end-to-end on the KV260 planned, not run Sources: C22 (baseline or parameter evolution)
g.text: Wrap the verified C22 IP with DDR

g.title: W21 Sub-kernel cache layout One change in the parameter transformer: cache indexed by sub-kernel HLS 1.75 ms Passes HLS gates narrowly; needs RTL and routing passed with warning Sources: W19 (baseline or parameter evolution) (source outside this route)

E065 Conv2-only 8-bit weights Mixed precision point: only Conv2 weights and bias to signed 8-bit 13 images: dPSNR -0.0759 dB analysis Sources: E017 (numerical evidence or inspiration) (source outside this route)

P01 Packing PE: two 8-bit products per DSP 27-bit packed multiply, gap 18, signed-low borrow repair PE only: 1 DSP per pair, exact partial experiment, no whole-design metric Sources: E043 (numerical evidence or inspiration) (source outside this route)

F47 Window FIFO 2 -> 16 Only the transformed-window FIFO depth, after F97's stall evidence RTL 535,771 cycles (F48) passed, comparable metric Sources: W21 (baseline or parameter evolution), F97 (numerical evidence or inspiration) (source outside this route)
